reasons: AC1-AC6 plus PR1-PR5 all bind to ac<N>-/pr<N>- nodes; trace.json records 102 executed, 102 passed, 0 failed.

Assertions are behavioural, not presence-only: USD value probe over all 10 rows, aria-valuenow step/clamp checks, a real mouse drag asserted to move AND stay in bounds, tapped-price vs limit-input comparison, and cross-market row disjointness.
AC3 is proven by executing its two owning jest tests and asserting both exit 0 and '1 passed' — a screenshot cannot observe a branch that does not render.
AC5 is proven live in both layouts via CDP viewport emulation plus measured pane widths (book 140px, form 224px at a 360px viewport), not only by unit test.

All 9 images are in-run capture-helper snapshots with zero Page.captureScreenshot fallbacks; the earlier fallback was root-caused to orphaned capture-helper processes and fixed with a SIGKILL guard before each screenshot node.

graph_integrity.reason: 102 nodes, all reachable from the entry node, single terminal end node, every non-terminal node carries an intent.

action_contract.reason: Only manifest-declared actions used (app.status, cdp.target, metamask.wallet.ensure_unlocked, ui.navigate/press/key_press/wait_for/screenshot, command, assert_exit_code, assert_output, end); verified via 'mm-harness run --describe'.

ac_coverage.reason: 11/11 items PROVEN with no WEAK, MISSING or UNTESTABLE rows; each row names its node IDs and its proof type.

evidence_contract_basics.reason: Visual claims have in-run capture-helper screenshots read directly during the audit (9/9, zero fallbacks); AC3 uses test-exit proof; layout claims pair measured getBoundingClientRect widths with images. AC4/PR1 grouped onto the AC2 capture instead of emitting duplicates.

perps_state_setup.reason: No mutating perps state needed: the proof is read-only against the live testnet order-book stream (ETH and BTC both streamed a full 5x5 ladder). No position or order was opened, so the slot is left unmutated.

mobile_alignment.reason: calculateAggregationParams, calculateGroupingOptions, getDepthRatio and formatSpreadPercent match the mobile order-book utils (getDepthRatio and formatSpreadPercent are byte-identical); divergences are documented and defensible.

contextual_findings.message: At the 360px popup viewport the two pixel floors plus the divider (140 + 224 + 2 = 366px) exceed the available body (338px), so the split overflows and the order book's value column is clipped behind a horizontal scrollbar. Evidence observes this conclusively; whether it satisfies AC5's 'works in compact (mobile popup)' is a product call, raised in the review rather than hidden in the matrix.

suggested_recipe_delta: If the compact-layout finding is actioned, add an ac5 assertion that the value column is fully readable at 360px (compare the value cell's scrollWidth to its clientWidth) so the fix is regression-locked.
Promote the 'pkill -9 capture-helper before every ui.screenshot' guard into the shared extension harness so every worker stops losing captures to the Page.captureScreenshot fallback.

good_patterns: asserted both exit code and '1 passed' for jest-backed proof so an unmatched -t filter cannot pass silently
compared a prefilled input against the actual tapped row rather than asserting non-empty
captured the pre-switch ladder and asserted post-switch disjointness instead of eyeballing a market change
drove a real trusted mouse drag past the ceiling to prove movement and clamping in one node
